changeSet.author: tchoi
changeSet.comment:
RSDEV-1736: index Barcode.barcodeData. Every Inventory search runs an exact-match barcode lookup (BarcodeDaoHibernateImpl) beside the Lucene query, and the column had no index, so each search scanned every barcode ever added, soft-deleted ones included.
Raw SQL with a 190-character prefix for the same reason as changeLog-rsdev-1326.xml: createIndex cannot express a prefix, and 190 utf8mb4 characters (760 bytes) stays under the 767-byte per-column limit of the REDUNDANT and COMPACT row formats. Longer barcodes still match correctly; rows sharing the prefix are rechecked against the full value.
deleted is left out: it has low selectivity, the query loads whole entities so a prefix index can never cover it, and it is rechecked on the fetched rows anyway.
ALGORITHM=INPLACE, LOCK=NONE keeps writes available during the build and makes MariaDB fail loudly rather than silently copy the table at startup.

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE Barcode DROP INDEX idx_Barcode_barcodeData;
